proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the scoped four-way equivalence, a canonical two-block elimination certificate, legal bounded-intensity witnesses for every obstruction, and the exact zero–one worst-case total-variation frontier. Both mathematical and decision panels passed with no findings, but the cold referee rated the fully strengthened package subfield because of its narrow process-only scope, reliance on published sufficiency for the positive direction, and lack of an applied demonstration. Raising the tier would require a material new program such as retained baselines or an empirical layer; dropping the intervention-admissibility conditions or claiming every-law failure would be invalid.
tldr: Replacing a treatment counting-process intensity by the same bounded retained-filtration-predictable \(\eta\) before or after hiding latent processes has a sharp graphical boundary.  On the intervention-specific process-only Røysland anchor-pair domain with explicit support, density-martingale, and dual-law uniqueness requirements, universal commutation is equivalent to block eliminability, to emptiness of the latent common-ancestor set \(C\), and to absence of a treatment-incident bidirected edge in the cyclic latent projection.  The canonical certificate is \((U\setminus K,K)\).  If the criterion fails, every offending latent fork supports bounded finite-clock witnesses whose total-variation discrepancy is arbitrarily close to one; hence the worst-case discrepancy is exactly zero in the safe regime and one in the obstructed regime.
gap: Published eliminability is sufficient, not known to be necessary, so a failed eliminability check does not currently tell an analyst whether the graph is truly unsafe or merely defeats one proof rule.
